Games/ThunderatTrail Blazers
Trail Blazers 118Thunder 108

Avdija's 28 finishes Portland's sweep of OKC

Final · Wed, Nov 11 · Portland

Deni Avdija scored 28 and Portland swept the back-to-back.

▶ Jump to the play

1 · What happened

The game, in 5 parts.

THE STORY · SCROLL
1 of 5 · First half

How it started.

The Thunder led 32–28 after one quarter. At the half, the Trail Blazers led 56–50.

2 of 5 · The difference

Avdija: 28 points, 6 assists, 4 steals

12 by halftime, 6 of 6 at the line.

3 of 5 · How it turned

Won the second quarter 28–18

Down 4 after one quarter, the Trail Blazers won the second quarter 28–18 to lead 56–50. Avdija and Lillard combined for 46 of 118.

4 of 5 · Where it was won

Won it from three and at the line

Threes made 19–11; blocks 8–3. Portland made all 14 of its fourth-quarter free throws.

5 of 5 · Final

Trail Blazers 118, Thunder 108.

From the Thunder’ side: Lost the second quarter 18–28, the stretch that decided it.

What it meant: Trail Blazers 8–3, 5th in the West, 53% top-6 odds. Thunder 8–4, 7th in the West, 93%.
